title: Securing Fairness in Regulatory Timing Act of 2015
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was passed by the House on December 10, 2015. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

Securing Fairness in Regulatory Timing Act of 2015

(Sec. 2) This bill amends title XVIII (Medicare) of the Social Security Act to extend from 45 days to 60 days the annual notice period for the announcement of payment rates under Medicare Advantage (MA). MA organizations shall have at least 30 days to comment on proposed changes.

summary.headline: A 2015 law lengthens the advance notice period for Medicare Advantage payment rate announcements from 45 to 60 days.
summary.what_it_does: This law changes the Social Security Act's Medicare rules. It extends the annual notice period for announcing Medicare Advantage payment rates from 45 days to 60 days. It also gives Medicare Advantage organizations at least 30 days to comment on proposed changes.

who_it_affects.how: They get at least 60 days' notice of the annual payment rate announcement instead of 45, and at least 30 days to comment on proposed changes.
